title: DependencyBlessedAllowlist
description: Data-driven hyperscaler-blessed direct-dependency allowlist consumed by Buck2/Prow dependency checks. Each crate own dependencies are read at lane time; every DIRECT external dependency (path/workspace-internal oya-* deps are exempt) is checked against this allowlist. Unblessed direct deps are reported per-crate with the crate path. This file is the source of truth for the blessed set so the policy is data-driven, not hard-coded.

_meta.purpose: Authoritative per-crate hyperscaler-blessed direct-dependency allowlist for Buck2/Prow dependency checks.
_meta.exemptions: Workspace-internal crates (name prefix oya-) and any dependency declared with an explicit `path = ...` are exempt: they are first-party code, not external supply-chain surface.
_meta.library_posture: in_house_first_oya_rust_libraries; external crates are blessed seam exceptions only

anyhow.rationale: Error aggregation for CLI/tooling and application-edge orchestration. Governed by dependency-rationales.json.

bytes.rationale: Byte buffer type for hyper bodies; isolated in oya-http-runtime-hyper-adapter per ADR-0092 D2.

clap.rationale: Canonical CLI argument parser for cli/app crates.

http-body-util.rationale: Hyper body utilities (Limited, collect); isolated in the hyper adapter per ADR-0092 D2.

hyper.rationale: Canonical HTTP backbone per ADR-0090; PREFERRED low-level default for the strategic hyper/axum split (ADR-0090 Amendment 2026-05-29 + specs/http-stack-policy.json). Isolated in oya-http-runtime-hyper-adapter.

hyper-util.rationale: Hyper server/connection builders; isolated in the hyper adapter per ADR-0090/0092.

hyper-rustls.rationale: Rustls TLS connector for the hyper backbone; adapter-only TLS termination. Pre-approved runtime crate.

axum.rationale: SANCTIONED strategic exception for *-rest / control-plane crates (ADR-0509 §6 rest/ mod). Each adopting crate must carry a recorded justification in specs/http-stack-policy.json (justified_crates.axum), enforced by the oya-dev-cli http-stack gate; hyper is the preferred low-level default.

tower.rationale: Service middleware abstraction layered under axum/hyper. Pre-approved runtime crate.

tower-http.rationale: HTTP middleware (trace, timeout, compression) over tower. Pre-approved runtime crate.

futures-util.rationale: Async combinators for stream/sink glue at adapter and runtime seams. Pre-approved runtime crate.

tokio.rationale: Canonical async runtime for runtime/app crates.

tracing-subscriber.rationale: Tracing collector/exporter configuration at the app/runtime edge.

serde_json.rationale: JSON (de)serialization for DTOs, registries, and evidence.

serde_yaml.rationale: YAML parsing for tooling/gate manifests and Helm/IaC values.

prost.rationale: Protobuf codegen runtime for gRPC contracts.

protoc-bin-vendored.rationale: Vendored protoc binary for hermetic gRPC builds.

ring.rationale: Constant-time cryptographic primitives. Pre-approved blessed crypto crate.

thiserror.rationale: Typed domain error derive for kernel/domain crates. Pre-approved blessed error crate.

sqlx.rationale: Async Postgres driver for infrastructure persistence adapters.

kube.rationale: Kubernetes client + controller-runtime for the managed-k8s control-plane-host CAPI adapter (ADR-0376). Isolated to oya-managed-k8s-control-plane-host-adapter-capi ONLY; the live Kamaji TenantControlPlane / Talos control-plane CRD reconciliation is honest-deferred per registry/placeholder-debt/adr-follow-ups.yaml#kamaji-provider-live-integration.

kube-runtime.rationale: Kube controller-runtime primitives (watcher/reflector/Controller) for the managed-k8s control-plane-host CAPI adapter (ADR-0376). Adapter-only seam alongside kube; live reconciliation honest-deferred.

k8s-openapi.rationale: Kubernetes API object types for the managed-k8s control-plane-host CAPI adapter (ADR-0376). Adapter-only seam alongside kube; isolated to oya-managed-k8s-control-plane-host-adapter-capi.

regex.rationale: Regular expressions for tooling/gate text scans.

toml.rationale: TOML parsing for Cargo manifests and tooling config.

walkdir.rationale: Recursive directory traversal for tooling/gate file scans.

tempfile.rationale: Temporary directories/files for tests and tooling fixtures.

cedar-policy.rationale: AWS Cedar authorization engine (Apache-2.0, OSI-clean): formally-verified default-deny + forbid-overrides-permit policy evaluation. Isolated to the workload-authz adapter per ADR-0183; named in microservices/identity/manifest.json#consumes_upstream_oss.

clickhouse.rationale: ClickHouse 26.3 LTS HTTP client (Apache-2.0). Isolated exclusively to oya-shared-olap-clickhouse-adapter per ADR-0092 D2 and ADR-0193 OLAP analytics warehouse mandate. No kernel or domain crate may depend on this crate directly.

aws-lc-rs.rationale: Phase-1 crypto backend per ADR-0506; wrapped by first-party crypto/TLS seams.

hmac.rationale: HMAC primitive for webhook verification; request semantics stay in first-party code.

reqwest.rationale: Temporary outbound HTTP client for GitHub/Prow bridge and gateway adapters; destination is in-house oya-http-client over hyper where practical.

rustls.rationale: Rust TLS implementation for adapter/runtime edges using the AWS-LC backend; policy semantics stay first-party.

sha2.rationale: SHA-2 primitive paired with HMAC for webhook verification; canonicalization and audit stay first-party.

subtle.rationale: Constant-time comparison helper for signature verification.
